caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden board displayed vertically on a neutral beige background. Carved into the surface of the wooden board are six distinct relief designs arranged in two columns and three rows. In the upper left corner, there is a motif of a central figure surrounded by ornate floral patterns. To its right is a symmetrical heart-shaped design containing a smaller central object that appears to be a cup or urn. In the middle left, another elaborate floral motif is present, mirroring the complexity of the upper left design. Adjacent to this, in the middle right, is an oval with an image of a tall building or tower set within a landscape. In the bottom left corner, there is a detailed carving of a standing lion with a raised tail. To the lion's right, a circular wreath-like pattern completes the bottom row. The entire board has a consistent natural brown color, with lines and shading used to convey the texture and depth of the carvings. The background of the drawing is plain, with the focus solely on the carved board. The artist's name, "PR.TZ. BOEMMER," appears in small print at the bottom right of the image.
title: Springerle for Christmas Cookies
